messages:
maya_partners: kickoff: building a CrossCloud IAC Accelerator kit for marketplace partners. goal: one terraform module set that works for CloudAtlas + Nimbus vendors with minimal swaps.
lin_cloud: love it. v0: module + 2 example varsets + CI smoke in single region. packaging optional.
oscar_infra: keep provider pins and include example backend.tf (s3/gcs) with kms. CI should destroy in the same run.
rachel_prod: add a 1-line cost estimate and dev/prod sizing in README. also a two-sentence marketing blurb we can hand to partners.
docs-bot: I'll draft quickstart and partner-review checklist, include known limitations (arm64 caveats).
build-bot: repo created: github.com/redwood/crosscloud-iac-accelerator by maya_partners
oscar_infra: small sample app: python flask with /health and /metrics (opt-in). add promises for telemetry opt-in only.
maya_partners: timeline: internal review in 6 days, partner tech-share in 20 days. aiming to skip packaging for the first review.
lin_cloud: ping me when PR is open, i'll check marketplace packaging notes for CloudAtlas specifics.
maya_partners: opening PR today, tagging reviewers. thanks! :rocket:
